bio.text: Leticia Castillo, a Republican, represents the 58th Assembly District, which covers parts of Riverside and San Bernardino counties, in the California State Assembly.

In June 2023 the Raincross Gazette reported that Castillo, a resident of Home Gardens, worked for the County of Riverside as a mental health clinical therapist and was a CAGOP delegate and Vice President of the Riverside Republican Assembly.
